The '''03-R cryogenic power cell''' was a [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] produced by [[Thiodyne/Legends|Thiodyne]] and used in the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]]. It fuelled the fighter's internal [[ionization reactor]].
